RWA.note: Page describes an IremboGov account login for a land service; it states no authentication, e-signature or digital ID service.
No civil register link to the ID is stated.
No ID enrolment count or share is stated.
No number at birth is stated.
No operator, maintainer or owner of the ID system is stated.
Page says the parcel UPI must align with the seller's ID but does not say the land register is keyed on the national ID number.
Page only asks for a national ID or passport; nothing on the ID system itself.
Page mentions clearing taxes with RRA and a company TIN, but states nothing about a computerised taxpayer register.
